units.source_text: 天终于亮起来，山寺晨钟之声也听到了。

en.t: At last day broke, and the sound of the morning bell from the mountain temple could be heard.

units.source_text: 薰君推想匂亲王现正酣睡，全无起身的样子，心中不胜妒恨，故作咳嗽声催他起来。

en.t: Lord Kaoru imagined that Prince Niou was now sleeping soundly, showing no sign at all of getting up; overcome with jealousy and resentment, he deliberately coughed to urge him awake.
This behavior, too, was rather strange.
He composed a poem and said:
